issue_context.title: [Bug]: WebKit / Linux support avif image format
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.47.1

### Steps to reproduce

1. Clone repo at https://github.com/pinanks/pw-img-webkit-linux
2. Run `./generate-ss.sh`

### Expected behavior

![render-with-cache-response-ss](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f0ba6f76-cd5f-4f1c-9667-fb2d6ab254a3)


### Actual behavior

A blank screenshot

![render-with-cache-response-ss](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d239893e-5f36-469f-8188-1f5fceafc36d)


### Additional context

I am trying to render HTML with assets such as CSS/images etc cached and using page.route to intercept and fulfill with cached response. Everything works fine on my local machine (Apple M3 Pro, OS: Sonoma 14.1, everything else is same) but it fails on a Linux container.

The issue is that the img is not rendered and I get a blank screenshot. I also tried to have base64 of image as src directly in the html but it didn't work as well.

The repro will generate two screenshots for both these cases.

### Environment

```shell
System:
  OS: Docker image ubuntu:jammy
Binaries:
  Node: v20.17.0
  npm: v10.8.2
Playwright:
  @playwright/test: v1.47.1
```
comments: We currently compile our Linux builds without avif support - we'll look into enabling it.
This should be fixed in https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/33229 and available in [Canary](https://playwright.dev/docs/canary-releases) tomorrow.
Can the change by #3322 be easily applied to Windows?
